title: Jamie Oliver (@jamieoliver) • Instagram photos and videos
meta_description:
11M Followers, 4,444 Following, 12K Posts - Jamie Oliver (@jamieoliver) on Instagram: "Chef & Dad
Order my new 20 Minute Meals cookbook now ⏰
For loadsa recipes & more click below 👇"

posts.meta_description:
18K likes, 417 comments - jamieoliver on June 25, 2026: "Ha! You didn't think... 🤣

GUYS !! After 25 years, you know you can trust me to deliver joyful, super-tasty, easy, and exciting food. And my new book is ALL about getting food on the table quick and easy. For me, FAST = delicious, nutritious, home-cooked goodness! 

Like I said in the video, if a recipe couldn't be done in 20 minutes, it didn't make the cut! 

To prove it to you in real-time, my brand new @channel4 TV show Jamie's 20 Minute Meals was filmed in one continuous shot- so you can see for yourself if I actually pull it off under the clock !!!

Delicious dinner, done fast. Pre-order via the link in my bio now!

JO XXX #AD".

Kind, funny, always there for me and the kids. Honestly, I couldn’t have achieved anything I’m proud of without you. Here’s to even more adventures and laughs together bring on the next 25 years . Love you so much ❤️Happy 25 th wedding anniversary ❤️ jamie x5x  X x x".

Big love,

Jamie xxx
